description: This bar chart compares the performance scores of three Korean language models—RedWhale (our), EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base)—across six evaluation categories: PT-EVAL, KoBEST-BQ, KoBEST-CP, KoBEST-HS, KoBEST-SN, and AVG. The horizontal axis lists these categories, while the vertical axis represents performance scores, which are explicitly labeled with numerical values on top of each bar and range from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale. For each category, three bars are grouped side-by-side: the leftmost bar is dark purple for RedWhale (our), the middle bar is light blue for EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0, and the rightmost bar is light gray for SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base). The performance values are as follows: for PT-EVAL, RedWhale scores 0.42, EEVE scores 0.46, and SOLAR scores 1.00; for KoBEST-BQ, RedWhale scores 0.52, EEVE scores 0.56, and SOLAR scores 1.00; for KoBEST-CP, RedWhale scores 0.71, EEVE scores 0.74, and SOLAR scores 1.00; for KoBEST-HS, RedWhale scores 0.50, EEVE scores 0.54, and SOLAR scores 1.00; for KoBEST-SN, RedWhale scores 0.69, EEVE scores 0.73, and SOLAR scores 1.00; and for AVG, RedWhale scores 0.57, EEVE scores 0.61, and SOLAR scores 1.00. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the evaluation categories as listed on the x-axis. The SOLAR-10.7B-v1.0 (base) model consistently achieves a perfect score of 1.00 across all six categories, while RedWhale (our) and EEVE-Korean-10.8B-v1.0 show lower, comparable scores in each category.
